scope: 24 individual symbol briefs plus the previously approved Munagasah folio; every final logo also receives a separately rendered exact-name wordmark.

items.brief: One deep-indigo protective shield enclosing a warm ivory contract page. Two simple recessed clause lines appear on the page; a small coral magnifying ring is integrated with the lower-right page edge, clearly inspecting a clause. Shield and contract must be one bold, compact silhouette. Smoked indigo #0B192C, titanium #C5C9D0, ivory #F4E7D5, coral #E7655A. This is privacy-contract protection and source-linked review. No government emblems, approval check, keyhole or unrelated location marker.

items.concept: Residency dossier and open visa gateway
items.brief: A dignified residency-document symbol: one partially open burgundy residency booklet, ivory page block, and a single sculpted antique-gold arched doorway recessed into the cover. A small plain gold corner tab evokes a visa document, without seals, flags, stars, stamps, checks or government emblems. The open doorway is integrated into the booklet, not separate buildings. Clear document silhouette at 48 pixels. Colors burgundy #502C43, ivory #F7EBD7, antique gold #C29A5C.
Preserve the established interlocking pale-mint economic-zone volumes with the turquoise connector and deep-blue foundation.
Preserve the established pale-aqua ceramic civic-path ribbon and coastal-teal translucent endpoint.

items.concept: A workforce built around local opportunity
items.brief: Three clear upright stylized human figures with rounded heads, arranged inside a wide open deep-green architectural employment frame. The central figure is terracotta, the two side figures are jade and warm ivory. A shared solid foundation connects their roles; one small stepped gold/green hiring tab joins the frame. The idea is a balanced professional workforce and local hiring opportunity, not abstract arrows or plants. Forest green #174F40, jade #4C8668, terracotta #BE7154 and warm ivory. No flags, racial markers, demographic percentages, arrows or written labels.

An elegant dark-plum architectural corner balanced on two pale-lavender stone planes, with one muted-rose precision seam. Strong rectangular property silhouette, legal-editorial restraint. No arches, gavel, shield or justice scales.

A single refined copper bridge link spanning two malachite geometric anchors, with a cream inset that creates a clear connection. Strategic commercial confidence, sculptural but simple. No envelope, handshake or generic chain links.

An expressive magenta and blush folded-paper composition opening into three lilac editorial petals with asymmetric rhythm. Rich creative-studio identity, tactile paper, sophisticated color blocking. No text-like glyphs, document stack, chat bubble or generic flower.

Two precisely interlocking ocean-blue ceramic service loops with a mint inner path and pale-yellow joint. Rounded, welcoming, fluid but highly readable. No speech bubbles, headset, robot or infinity-symbol cliche.

Two miniature industrial-white and electric-blue cargo blocks held in a vivid-orange L-shaped shipment route. Bold ribbed container surfaces, precise logistics geometry, restrained industrial lighting. No globe, flag, ship, letters or tiny labels.

A refined charcoal evaluation frame around three warm-stone qualification tabs, aligned by one acid-lime precision cursor. Analytical and transparent, clear large shapes. No resume lettering, person silhouette, checkmark, magnifier or bar chart.

A modern corporate onboarding symbol: an open squared ultramarine office doorway with a single warm-ivory employee identity badge crossing the threshold. The badge bears only a simple sculpted human bust and two short recessed lines, no lettering. Three short orchid step-tabs integrate with the base, suggesting sequenced onboarding tasks. Compact dignified welcome into an organization, not a garden courtyard or real estate icon. Ultramarine #253CA5, porcelain ivory #F7F5EE and restrained orchid #B88AC8. No flags, palm trees, arches, handshake anatomy or approval check.

items.concept: A companion for an organized day
items.brief: A friendly sophisticated daily-planner symbol: a small warm-ivory calendar tile with two lavender binding tabs, three clearly separated peach and purple time blocks, and a compact purple clock dial integrated into its lower-right corner. The dial has only two clean hands, no numbers. The calendar and clock form one balanced silhouette; the open space between time blocks communicates breathing room. Colors violet #6D5B98, peach #F4A89D, ivory #F9EEE8. No heart, pebble, generic swirl or infinity symbol.

items.concept: Intentional time and rest during Ramadan
items.brief: An elegant single champagne-gold crescent embracing a compact hourglass with a deep-indigo frame and warm ivory sand. The hourglass is clearly recognizable with two balanced chambers, connecting productivity windows and intentional rest during Ramadan. Strong simple integrated silhouette, no schedule bars from the previous design. Midnight indigo #131F4D, gold #D0B87C and ivory #FFE8B0. No stars, sunburst, mosque, clock face, calendar tile, fake religious seal or countdown numerals.

Two parallel evergreen precision beams supporting a single sage stone orb in a poised balanced composition, with chalk inner faces. Restrained financial editorial sculpture. No money, coins, religious seal, scales of justice or upward arrow.

A tactile shallow terracotta plate with a Mediterranean-blue rim, holding one beautifully formed vanilla-colored culinary curl and a small green herb accent. Sensory premium food identity with simplified forms. No cutlery, lettering, certification stamp, menu or restaurant scene.

A warm ivory house cross-section with a precise aubergine roof and three nested peach-cream interior rooms, one dusty-rose room accent. Domestic ceramic architectural object, intimate and clear. No financial chart, coin, gateway or generic flat house pictogram.

A small parchment folded-map sculpture with slate-blue cartographic planes and one vivid-apricot route crossing a fold. Exploratory editorial identity, readable folded silhouette. No actual country outline, invented geographic labels, flag, passport or location pin.

An integrated resource-conservation emblem: a deep-green upright water droplet whose upper-right edge turns into a single crisp citron leaf; inside the droplet, two stepped ivory/green measurement columns separated by a slim open gap clearly communicate comparison of resource use. The drop, leaf and measured columns are one elegant bold silhouette. Restrained dimensional ceramic surfaces, not a liquid splash, atom or three-pronged abstract molecule. Colors evergreen #215B39, citron #BDD652, warm pale ivory #F8F8DA.

A humane mental-wellbeing and breathing symbol: a single calm eucalyptus-teal human face in side profile, eye softly closed, formed from a smooth rounded ceramic contour, with two short gently expanding pale-sage breath ribbons leaving the nose into generous open space. Face and breath should be immediately readable and form one compact mark. Softness without medical imagery: no lungs, brain, diagnostic cross, lotus, infinity loop or generic oval. Colors deep teal #4A7480, pale sage #AEC7BB and off-white #F0F4F1. Avoid uncanny realism; this is an elegant sculptural brand pictogram.

A single angular burnt-orange material loop with a recycled-paper cream laminated edge and one dark-petrol cut surface. Tactile fibers and clear circular-economy silhouette. No standard three-arrow recycling symbol, globe, leaf or trash bin.

A refined heritage-learning symbol: an open warm-parchment book whose central page fold rises into a single small stylized Gulf wind-tower/barjeel in sandstone, with four clearly cut ventilation openings and a restrained bronze rim. Book and heritage architecture are physically integrated into one strong silhouette. The purpose is learning history through source-backed reading, not an archaeological fragment or museum seal. Sandstone #CBA16A, parchment #F0E1C6 and bronze #805C3C. No invented inscriptions, emblems, Arabic lettering, flags or generic mosque dome.

A clear dignified accessible-mobility symbol: an original modern seated human figure with a round head, upright royal-blue torso and bent arm, above one wide open circular wheelchair wheel. The lower wheel flows directly into a short smooth barrier-free gold path. Recognizable accessible mobility at small scale, confidently independent, not a hospital sign. Compact and bold, no text or signboard, no stairs, no abstract ramp alone. Colors royal blue #10358C, sunflower gold #E7C93B, warm white #FFFCE8. Sculpted matte ceramic with restrained depth.

items.concept: Food surplus passed into caring hands
items.brief: A compact food-rescue and redistribution symbol: a deep terracotta-red food bowl with one stylized golden wheat sprig and a small green leaf emerging from it; two simplified warm-ivory cupped hand forms meet beneath the bowl from opposite sides, communicating sharing and transfer. Bowl, grain and hands form one deliberate coherent brand silhouette, not a still-life or fruit shopping icon. No tomato, badges, approval checks, arrows circle or delivery truck. Colors terracotta #A23E3C, harvest gold #F0BB52, cream #FCF3E4 and a restrained olive accent.
